description: Fetches a URL and evaluates 10 security-critical response headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection, CORP, COEP, COOP), detects anti-patterns, and returns an overall security grade (A–F).
